name: hardware-supplies-pricebook
description: Desktop pricebook for hardware supplies built with Electron, React, and Vite.

scripts.dev:main: tsup electron/main.ts --format cjs --splitting false --sourcemap --out-dir dist-electron --target node18 --watch
scripts.dev:preload: tsup electron/preload.ts --format cjs --splitting false --sourcemap --out-dir dist-electron --target node18 --watch
scripts.dev:electron: wait-on dist-electron/main.js dist-electron/preload.js tcp:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron .
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:types && npm run build:main && npm run build:preload && vite build
scripts.build:main: tsup electron/main.ts --format cjs --splitting false --sourcemap --out-dir dist-electron --target node18
scripts.build:preload: tsup electron/preload.ts --format cjs --splitting false --sourcemap --out-dir dist-electron --target node18
